company.name: Harris Pye
company.shortDescription: Harris Pye is an energy company that provides engineering and project management services to marine, offshore, and industrial sectors.
company.description:
We Are Harris Pye
The Harris Pye Engineering Group is a rapidly expanding global organisation specialising in the provision of repairs, upgrades and conversions to the marine, offshore oil and gas and associated onshore industrial sectors. Operating worldwide on a 24/7 basis, our philosophy is to provide a global service with a focus on supplying top quality products and fast and efficient customer service.
